bullets.text: Corporation workers are removing water hyacinth and garbage in the Besant Nagar estuary area, and the office should monitor cleanliness drives.
Pallikaranai hosted a free employment camp where 300 people received work orders, and the office should track local skilling initiatives.
Farmers staged a sit-in protest outside the Gummidipoondi taluk office demanding house site pattas, and the office should address their grievances.
Ayappakkam residents faced a six-month water shortage due to illegal groundwater extraction and selling, and the district team must intervene.
Authorities caught 12 people adulterating river sand with sea sand and M-sand in Sengundram, and the office should ensure strict enforcement.
India faces risks to its AI ambitions if Washington implements Donald Trump's threatened taxes on US data centres built abroad, so the portfolio team must monitor US policy shifts.
Karnataka is rolling out an AI-based facial recognition attendance system for higher education, and the ministry should study its implementation for potential state adoption.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that AI cannot replace skilled workers, and the department should align its digital training programs with this vision.
